svg.text: Figure 15-2. Publish Pipeline, Social Graph Service, Timeline Store, and Ranking Path.

g.text: Control Plane (Ranking Models, Social Graph & Fan-Out Thresholds)
Feature weights · Sharded follower edge lists · Celebrity fan-out cutoff (> 100k)
Data Plane (Publish Fan-Out & Low-Latency Feed Read Assembly)
Top lane: author device -> durable publish -> fan-out | Bottom lane: merge -> rank -> reader device
Solid: Sync publish & read assembly (1-2 Publish, 4-5 Merge & Rank)
Dashed: Async Kafka fan-out (3), hydrate & control gutters

svg.text: Timeline entries store compact 8-byte post IDs rather than full
payloads so active feeds remain memory-resident in Redis.
Fan-out workers act as the sole asynchronous writers to user timelines (3), preventing write
contention while allowing the feed aggregator to hydrate and rank candidates on read (4-5).
